pinTab.enterCurrent: Enter your current PIN to make changes.
pinTab.replaceExisting: Enter a new 4-digit PIN. This replaces your existing PIN.
pinTab.setIntro: A 4-digit PIN opens your protected notes and your recovery phrase. It syncs to every device.
pinTab.protectReason: Protected notes need a PIN, because the lock travels to your other devices and your fingerprint does not.
pinTab.reaskHint: Applies to the phrase view and any PIN-protected notes.
pinTab.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}}s.

pinInfo.title: Require PIN to view
pinInfo.body: When enabled, your PIN is required every time you open this item, even if the app is already unlocked. Use it for sensitive items that should stay protected when you step away.

removePinDialog.title: Remove PIN
removePinDialog.introWithBio: Enter your current PIN to confirm removal. Biometric unlock stays active, but your only fallback will be your recovery phrase.
removePinDialog.introNoBio: Enter your current PIN to confirm removal. Your recovery phrase screen will then open without a PIN.

pinRecovery.title: Reset your PIN
pinRecovery.intro: Type your 12-word recovery phrase to clear the PIN. You can set a new one straight after.
pinRecovery.lockIntro: Enter your 12-word recovery phrase. It unlocks the app and clears the PIN.
pinRecovery.consequence: The PIN is cleared on all your devices. Biometric unlock is not affected.
pinRecovery.wrongPhrase: That is not the recovery phrase for this account.
pinRecovery.cleared: PIN cleared. Set a new one below, or leave it off.

phraseGate.enterToView: Enter your 4-digit PIN to view your phrase.
phraseGate.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}}s.
phraseGate.enterToChangeCustody: Enter your 4-digit PIN to change key custody.
phraseGate.checkFailed: Your PIN could not be checked. Try again.

phraseView.calloutWords: These 12 words are the only way into your notes. Lose them and your data is gone.
phraseView.sealedBody: Anyone who reads these 12 words can open your notes. Make sure nobody is looking over your shoulder.
phraseView.sealedFootnote: Set a PIN to lock this screen for good.
phraseView.sealedFootnotePin: It hides itself again after a minute.

custody.rowDeviceCustodial: Sign in with {{provider}}, nothing to type
custody.rowDeviceCustodialGeneric: Sign in with your account, nothing to type
custody.rowDeviceSelf: Type 12 words or scan a QR
custody.rowLostCustodial: A connected account can restore the phrase. 2FA still applies when enabled.
custody.rowLostSelf: Without another saved copy or an unlocked device, the notes cannot be recovered.
custody.rowKeyCustodial: On our server and your devices
custody.releaseWarning: Save your 12-word phrase outside PrivacyNotes first. After we delete our copy, you will need it on new devices.
custody.challengePrompt: Type these words from the list above to confirm you have them.
custody.releaseDone: Done. We no longer hold a copy of your phrase. New devices will ask for these 12 words or a QR scan.
custody.adoptDone: Saved. We now hold an encrypted copy of your phrase, so a new device signs in without it. You can change this back here at any time.
custody.checkingSession: Checking your sign-in. Your current custody setting is shown below.
custody.sessionUnavailable: Your sign-in could not be checked. Reconnect and try again before changing key custody.
custody.wrongVaultSession: The server session belongs to a different account. Sign in to this vault again before changing key custody.
custody.signInToChange: Sign in to this vault to change key custody. Notes already on this device stay available.
custody.connectToStore: Storing your phrase with us requires a connected account and an eligible sign-in to this vault.
custody.connectingIsSeparate: Connecting an account does not store your phrase on our server. Changing key custody is a separate choice.
custody.rowDeviceSelfProvider: Sign in with {{provider}}, then enter your 12 words
custody.rowDeviceSelfConnected: Sign in with a connected account, then enter your 12 words
custody.checkingConnections: Checking connected accounts before changing key custody...
custody.connectionsUnavailable: Connected accounts could not be checked. Try again before storing your phrase with us.
custody.rowDeviceCustodialSafeGeneric: Sign in with a connected account
custody.mfaStillApplies: If two-factor sign-in is on, new server sessions also require your authenticator code in either mode.
custody.checkSavedPhrase: I saved my phrase. Check my copy
custody.hiddenChallengePrompt: The phrase is hidden. Enter these words from the copy you saved outside PrivacyNotes.
custody.phraseHiddenForCheck: Your phrase is hidden while you check the copy you saved.
custody.changeFailed: The change could not be confirmed. Check your connection and try again.
custody.openPhrase: View and back up your phrase

biometricTab.description: Unlock with your fingerprint or face. Adds a biometric gate so others nearby can't access your notes.
biometricTab.trustFirst: Turn on "Trust this device" first. Biometric unlock and the app lock both keep a copy of your recovery phrase on this device, which is not what an untrusted device is for.
biometricTab.notAvailable: Biometric unlock is not available on this device. Your browser or hardware doesn't support a platform authenticator (Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello).
biometricTab.lockOnOpenHint: Require biometric or PIN when opening the app.
biometricTab.lockHidesOnSwitch: Also hides your notes when you switch apps.
biometricTab.lockNeedsCredential: The app lock needs a PIN or biometric unlock on this device.
biometricTab.confirmPinForLock: Enter your PIN to turn this on. It locks a copy of your recovery phrase so only your PIN can open the app.
biometricTab.relockHint: Applies to the app lock screen only.
biometricTab.perDeviceNote: Biometric unlock opens the same notes as your PIN. It stays on this device and never syncs.
biometricTab.disableConfirmBody: Disable biometric unlock on this device?
biometricTab.disableConfirmBodyAppLock: Disable biometric unlock on this device? App lock will also be turned off.

appLock.phraseNotSaved: This device could not save your recovery phrase, so nothing was changed. Try again.

pinSetup.title: Set a PIN
pinSetup.description: A 4-digit PIN will be required to view your recovery phrase. Optional, but recommended for shared spaces.

protectedGate.biometricFailed: Biometric verification failed or was cancelled.
protectedGate.biometricSubtitle: Use your fingerprint or face to unlock this item.
protectedGate.disableBiometricSubtitle: Use your fingerprint or face to confirm.
protectedGate.disableSubtitle: The note stays where it is. Only the lock comes off.
protectedGate.verifySubtitle: Enter your 4-digit PIN to unlock this item. The unlock lasts for the timeout you set in Security.
protectedGate.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}}s.
protectedGate.bootstrapSubtitle: This item is PIN-protected, but no PIN is set on this device. Set a 4-digit PIN to unlock it. Your PIN syncs across all your devices.
protectedGate.bootstrapWarning: Setting a PIN here does not require knowledge of the prior PIN. Anyone holding your recovery phrase can do this on a fresh device. For truly sensitive content, rely on phrase-only auth instead.
protectedGate.deleteSubtitle: Enter your PIN to delete this protected item.

lockScreen.subtitleWithBio: Use your fingerprint, face, or PIN to continue.
lockScreen.biometricFailed: Biometric verification failed or was cancelled.
lockScreen.signInFailed: Unlocked, but signing you back in did not work - check your connection.
lockScreen.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}}s.
lockScreen.recoveryPhraseSubtitle: Enter your 12-word recovery phrase to unlock.
lockScreen.invalidPhrase: Invalid phrase. Check spelling and word order.
lockScreen.phrasePlaceholder: word1 word2 word3 word4 word5 word6 word7 word8 word9 word10 word11 word12

deviceLimit.title: Device limit reached
deviceLimit.body: Free accounts can sync on up to {{limit}} devices at a time. You already have {{count}}. Remove one to continue on this device, or upgrade for unlimited devices.
deviceLimit.upgradeBody: One-time payment, no subscription. Unlimited devices plus images, note history, and more.
deviceLimit.needMoreBody: Pro upgrades aren't available on this build. If you genuinely need a third device, reach out and we'll sort it.
deviceLimit.saveRecoveryBody: You signed in with OAuth. Write down your 12-word phrase too. It's your fallback if OAuth ever fails or you're locked out across devices.

phraseOdds.title: Can somebody guess my phrase?
phraseOdds.answerRest: And nobody else will ever get the same one.
phraseOdds.countLabel: Your device picked your 12 words from this many possible phrases:
phraseOdds.bitcoinTitle: Over a trillion dollars in Bitcoin
phraseOdds.bitcoinBody: People protect it with the same kind of 12-word phrase.
phraseOdds.universeTitle: 700 times the age of the universe
phraseOdds.universeBody: To try every phrase, at a billion billion guesses a second.
phraseOdds.twinTitle: Nobody on Earth has your phrase
phraseOdds.twinBody: Not even if all 8 billion of us used PrivacyNotes.
phraseOdds.keepPrivate: The only way in is your actual 12 words. Keep them private.

connectedAccounts.title: Connected accounts
connectedAccounts.description: Choose which accounts can sign in to this vault. Connecting or disconnecting an account keeps your notes and key custody unchanged.
connectedAccounts.signedInPhrase: You signed in with your 12-word phrase.
connectedAccounts.custodial: We store an encrypted copy of your phrase. Keep at least one connected account, or switch to self-custody before disconnecting the last one.
connectedAccounts.selfCustody: On a new device, a connected account still needs your 12-word phrase to open your notes. Connecting an account does not store the phrase with us.
connectedAccounts.mfaRequired: Two-factor sign-in stays on for all sign-in methods. Keep your authenticator or its saved backup key.
connectedAccounts.unavailable: Connected account changes are not available yet. Your existing sign-in still works.
connectedAccounts.updateDescription: This prepares your saved phrase and connected accounts to use two-factor sign-in and lets you manage connected accounts. Your notes and key custody stay unchanged.
connectedAccounts.updateDevices: Update the app on your other devices before continuing. They may need to sign in again.
connectedAccounts.updateAcknowledgment: I updated PrivacyNotes on my other devices.
connectedAccounts.setupDescription: The first connection needs a one-time update of this vault. Your notes and key custody stay the same.
connectedAccounts.closed: Connecting and removing accounts opens soon. Until then, you sign in the way you do now.
connectedAccounts.repairDescription: This vault already uses the updated sign-in. Reconnect this device using the phrase already unlocked here. Your local notes stay available.
connectedAccounts.reclaimDescription: Server access for this vault was removed. Use the phrase already unlocked on this device to reconnect it. Your local notes stay here.
connectedAccounts.connectWaiting: Finish signing in to the account you want to connect. Your current vault stays open.
connectedAccounts.returnLink: Return link from the sign-in page
connectedAccounts.returnHelp: If the sign-in page does not return automatically, use its Copy return link button and paste the link here.
connectedAccounts.invalidReturn: That return link does not belong to this connection. Copy the full link from the page you just opened.
connectedAccounts.connectCancelled: Connection cancelled. Your existing accounts are unchanged.
connectedAccounts.connectExpired: This connection attempt expired. Start again from Connected accounts.
connectedAccounts.popupBlocked: The sign-in window was blocked. Allow popups for PrivacyNotes and try again.
connectedAccounts.connectFailed: The sign-in could not be completed. Your existing accounts are unchanged. Try again.
connectedAccounts.anotherVault: That account already belongs to another vault. Choose a different account. Your vaults have not been merged.
connectedAccounts.rateLimited: Too many account changes were attempted. Wait a little, then try again.
connectedAccounts.connectionMissing: This account is no longer connected. Check the current account list before trying again.
connectedAccounts.noAccounts: No provider accounts are connected. Your saved phrase is your sign-in method.
connectedAccounts.actionFailed: The change could not be confirmed. Check your connection and try again.
connectedAccounts.connectDone: Account connected to this vault. Key custody is unchanged.
connectedAccounts.disconnectDone: Account disconnected. Your notes and key custody are unchanged.
connectedAccounts.connectKeepsCustody: This adds a sign-in method for the notes you have open. It does not change where your phrase is stored.
connectedAccounts.noMerge: An account already connected to another vault cannot be connected here. Vaults and their notes are never merged by this action.
connectedAccounts.freshMfa: You will need a fresh authenticator code to confirm this change. Two-factor sign-in stays on afterward.
connectedAccounts.lastCustodial: This is your last connected account. Connect another account first, or save your phrase and switch to self-custody before removing it.
connectedAccounts.remainingAccounts: After removal, you can sign in with {{providers}} or your saved phrase.
connectedAccounts.phraseOnly: After removal, your saved 12-word phrase will be your only sign-in method.
connectedAccounts.confirmSavedPhrase: Check the copy you saved outside PrivacyNotes. Enter all 12 words before disconnecting this account. The phrase is not shown here.
connectedAccounts.savePhrase: I need to save my phrase first

mfaPrompt.title: Enter your 2FA code
mfaPrompt.enterCode: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code.
mfaPrompt.noFactor: No authenticator found for this sign-in. Sign in again.
mfaPrompt.verificationFailed: That code did not work. Try the newest code in your app.
mfaPrompt.retry: This sign-in still needs a code. Try again.
mfaPrompt.unavailable: Could not check 2FA. Try again when you are online.
mfaPrompt.wrongLogin: This sign-in belongs to a different vault. Sign in again with your phrase or a connected account.
mfaPrompt.restore: Add your backup key to any authenticator app, then enter its code in PrivacyNotes.
mfaPrompt.noBackup: No phone and no backup key? We do not reset 2FA, and our support cannot help with it. Export the notes on this device and start a new vault.
mfaPrompt.localNotes: Not now? Keep using the notes on this device. Sync starts again after you enter a code.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor sign-in
twoFactor.description: Ask for a code from your phone when you sign in on a new device.
twoFactor.unavailable: Could not check 2FA. Your notes on this device are safe. Check your connection and try again.
twoFactor.actionFailed: That did not work. Check your connection and try again. Your notes on this device are safe.
twoFactor.warning: Keep your phone or your backup key. If you lose both, you cannot sign in on a new device. This is for your own safety. We do not reset 2FA, and our support cannot help with it.
twoFactor.cannotEnroll: Sign in again with your phrase or a connected account to set up 2FA.
twoFactor.benefitCode: A new device asks for a code from your phone.
twoFactor.benefitPhrase: Your 12 words alone no longer get your notes from our server.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
twoFactor.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.openAuthenticator: On this phone? Open your authenticator app
twoFactor.copyFailed: Could not copy. Write the key down or save it as a file.
twoFactor.saveFailed: Could not save the file. Write the key down instead.
twoFactor.backupWarning: Lost your phone? This key brings your codes back. Keep it somewhere safe, outside PrivacyNotes.
twoFactor.confirmBackup: Type your backup key again from the previous step, then enter the code from your app.
twoFactor.enabledHelp: New devices ask for a code.
twoFactor.enabledNotice: 2FA is on. Your other devices may ask for a code.
twoFactor.multipleFactors: You have more than one authenticator. Removing this one keeps the others.
twoFactor.stillEnabled: The authenticator is still active. Try again when you are online.

demoTeaser.accounts: Create an account to connect Google, Apple or GitHub to your vault.
demoTeaser.keyCustody: Create an account to choose where your 12 words are kept: only with you, or also as an encrypted copy on our server.
demoTeaser.twoFactor: Create an account to turn on two-factor sign-in with an authenticator app.
